title: GaslessTransferToolInput
description: Send USDC gaslessly on a single EVM chain. Amount is in human-readable USDC (not base units).

chainKey.description: Target chain: eth=Ethereum Sepolia, base=Base Sepolia, arb=Arbitrum Sepolia

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC (e.g. 1.0 for 1 USDC, 0.5 for 50 cents USDC). Maximum 100 USDC.
